heading: Minimum frontage
measurement_basis: SDMC street-frontage definition and §§113.0246/131.0442(a) applied to PM 17383 Parcel 1
qualifier: This evaluates only the minimum-frontage rule. It does not establish access adequacy, driveway compliance, setback compliance, development capacity, or project approval.
